Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Ambedkar Nagar Hospital is scheduled to end on 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to attend the interview on or before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by the Medical Council of India and be registered with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules for Persons with Disabilities (PwD).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67700 per month, which is as per Level-11 of the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Senior Resident posts, with 3 vacancies for Medicine and 3 for Obst. & Gynae.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Ambedkar Nagar Hospital located?
faq.answer: Ambedkar Nagar Hospital is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110062.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
